svg.title: Dated events of the models in L13
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline from June 2024 to October 2026 with year marks at 2025 and 2026. Seven numbered dots, left to right, each with its month: tag 1, Jun 2024; tag 2, Oct 2024; tag 3, Jun 2025; tag 4, Sep 2025; tag 5, Apr 2026; tag 6, Jul 2026; tag 7, Aug 2026. Tags alternate above and below the axis; only the horizontal position carries data.
